item.title: AI 채용 도구는 인종적 편견과 체계적인 거부를 낳습니다. 26% Black & 15% Asian
item.description:
📝 신입사원 채용이 둔화되었습니다. The vendor we study screens applicants for many different positions across many employers. We find that people who submit multiple applications to positions screened by the same algorithmic hiring vendor are more likely to be rejected from every position to which they apply than would be true if the companies made decisions statistically independently from one another.
🔤 Original: AI Hiring Tools Yield Racial Bias and Systemic Rejection; 26% Black & 15% Asian
🔗 Read more: https://hai.stanford.edu/news/ai-hiring-tools-can-yield-racial-bias-and-systemic-rejection

item.title: 모달 자동 엔드포인트: 귀하가 소유한 최적화된 추론
